prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied existing Stellar Syndicates emblem.
Primary request: replace the two ambiguous interlocking S-like metal shapes inside the emblem with exactly ONE unmistakable capital letter S.

Make a single large, centered, continuous, connected metallic S. Its silhouette must read immediately as an ordinary capital S, with an open upper-right terminal and open lower-left terminal, a left-hand upper curve, a connected broad middle stroke, and a right-hand lower curve. Use clean angular/chamfered geometry appropriate to the original science-fiction logo. All sections belong to one continuous broad steel ribbon. Do not create a double S, mirrored S, two nested S letters, segmented chevrons, separate left/right glyphs, a number 5, or a dollar sign. Keep the S bold and readable even at icon size.

Preserve the original logo's surrounding structure: the same tall hexagonal gunmetal frame and its perspective, dark interior, brushed steel texture and bevel treatment, cyan edge reflections, thin cyan elliptical orbit, gold pointed accent at the top, red pointed accent at the bottom, original centered square composition and comfortable surrounding margin. Keep the central cyan four-point star at the center as a light accent over the middle stroke, but make sure the star's glow does not interrupt or obscure the continuous single-S silhouette. The one clear S is the visual priority.

Background: retain genuine transparency outside the emblem; keep the opaque dark recess within the hexagonal frame. Preserve existing alpha and clean antialiased edges, without a black background rectangle or checkerboard. Square image, matching original proportions, high-resolution clean finish.
No words, extra letters, added text, extra symbols, watermarks, or scenery. Change only the interior letter geometry as needed to show ONE S; preserve the emblem's recognizable overall design.
